title: Tau Thioflavin T Assay
author: Alexandra Netter-Glangeaud
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wxgffjw
materials: Molecular Devices Gemini XPS Microplate Reader
10 uM Heparin was added to each well.

steps.title: Prepare Thioflavin T Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1mM stock solution of Thioflavin T in dH2O.

substeps.instruction: Filter the solution through a 0.2 µm syringe filter

steps.title: Prepare Thioflavin T Working Solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the Thioflavin T stock in PBS pH 7.4 to a final concentration of 25 µM per well.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the volume per well is 100 µL

steps.title: Prepare Tau Aliquots
steps.instruction: Thaw Tau aliquots at room temperature immediately before use.

steps.title: Add Tau and Mix
steps.instruction: Add fibril, monomer, or both to the appropriate wells and mix by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Incubate Plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate and place it in a shaking incubator.

steps.title: Measure Fluorescence
steps.instruction: Measure fluorescence using a Molecular Devices Gemini XPS Microplate Reader with Softmax Pro software version 6.5.1.

substeps.instruction: Set Read Type to Well Scan
Set Excitation wavelength to 450 nm and Emission wavelength to 485 nm
Set Shake to 20 seconds before read

steps.title: Continue Incubation and Monitoring
steps.instruction: Re-seal the plate and return it to the shaking incubator at 37°C.

substeps.instruction: Take readings at regular intervals from 1 hour to 72 hours
